some furniture and a farmhouse interior to match the buildings I made [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5754]HERE[/url]

there's two furniture versions, a pastel version with pink and light purple as the main colours and a darker version without the pink.

INSTALLATION INSTRUCTIONS:

you must choose between the two furniture files (pastel or dark) choose ONE (depending on which one you prefer) and rename it furniture.xnb and place it in Content\Tilesheets overwriting the original file. 

as for the farmhouse.xnb file, this is the file that will change the bed and kitchen. you must place a copy of this in your Content folder, overwriting the original farmhouse.xnb file.
